text:
kiara: Heads-up — I'm prototyping the experiment creation flow in Console v2. I want to surface per-variant routing guards and quota caps in the UI before we wire telemetry. Pasting a rough API shape below, please holler if any glaring issues:
```json
{
  "experiment": "homepage-copy-test",
  "variants": [
    {"id":"A", "weight":80, "quota":10000},
    {"id":"B", "weight":20, "quota":2500, "guard":"latency_sla"}
  ],
  "routing": {"region_policy":"eu-primary", "fallback":"model-small"}
}
```

matt: q: how does quota interact with ramping? if quota hits, do we auto-shrink weight? or fail-over to fallback?

samir: we should never auto-shrink without an explicit signal. prefer automatic fallback routing to a holdback when quota is exhausted. quotas should trigger alerts and be soft limits for cost controls, not silent weight changes.

andrea: telemetry checklist: per-variant QPS, 95p latency, error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens. also emit an event when quota_breach occurs that includes chosen fallback route and reason. we need sample rate for full payloads.

jen: UI suggestion: show an "active capacity" line per variant (e.g., 2.1k/10k used) + badge "canary" if weight < 5%. default form should be simple; advanced toggle for quota rules (on_quota behavior, alarms).

kiara: plan: default behavior = "fallback" on quota breach; add an optional per-experiment flag `auto_scale_down` for canaries. will add telemetry hooks and the events and wire the UI. thinking to expose: 

`on_quota`: ["fallback","holdback","scale_down"]

deploy-bot: deploy queued: exp-console-api-v2 -> staging. ETA ~10m :rocket:

matt: small nit: ensure API returns 409 with reason = "quota_exhausted" so SDKs can distinguish and implement their own retry/fallback logic.

samir: also include header `X-Experiment-Variant` so downstream infra can attribute logs to variant without parsing payloads.

kiara: thanks all — I'll push the PR and tag reviewers. @andrea can you skim the telemetry events once I add them?
